dog.description_text:
It’s hard to look at Orion’s adorable little face and not smile! This sweet boy made the long journey to ARF from California after being found as a stray, and he arrived with plenty of personality to spare.
Orion is a fun, lovable guy who has a way of making himself memorable. He’s ready to trade his stray days for a family of his own—and he’s sure to bring plenty of love, laughter, and happy moments along the way!
